fields.title: Automated weekly report generation feature
fields.core_concept: Use AI to automatically generate weekly summary reports from captured data and meeting notes.
fields.elaboration: What if we could take all the voice captures from the week, combine them with calendar data, and automatically generate a comprehensive weekly report? It would save hours of manual summarization work.
fields.potential_value: Could save 2-3 hours per week on report generation. Would also ensure nothing gets missed.
fields.next_steps: Research existing AI summarization tools. Prototype with OpenAI API.
